parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: seconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-asset-trend --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-ww00b06 --cluster-id 590 --start-time 1668496310000 --end-time 1668496310000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aek007uq --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
